steps.description: Build cable retainer from medium azure cable clip (49283 geometry, not hand liftarm) and red axle.
warnings: Nominal source/CAD reconstruction; numerical fit is not independently verified.

steps.title: Robot Head · 14
steps.description: Add magenta short connector to retainer axle.
warnings: Nominal source/CAD reconstruction; numerical fit is not independently verified.

steps.title: Robot Head · 15
steps.description: Fit retainer to head assembly and route cables through/along it.
warnings: Nominal source/CAD reconstruction; numerical fit is not independently verified.

Nominal display seat beside the upper motor only. Flexible lead geometry is absent; the manual does not dimension the bundle, clip seat, cable lengths or exact route. Pitch parenting is playback ownership, not a rigid physical mount.

steps.title: Robot Head · 16
steps.description: Make four loose sample packages from green, blue, red and magenta 2 x 4 bricks with three vertical axle holes, stacking two same-color bricks each; violet remains the lesson sensor enum, not the physical magenta material.
warnings: Nominal source/CAD reconstruction; numerical fit is not independently verified.

steps.title: Robot Head · 17
steps.description: Show complete combined robot and four separate sample packages; turn/review view.
warnings: Nominal source/CAD reconstruction; numerical fit is not independently verified.
A/F are documented motor ports; which port drives which physical axis is unknown.
